summary: Frontend-only landing page for 'Easy Wedding Cards' fully verified. All 29 required data-testids present. All 10 images load (naturalWidth>0) on desktop and mobile. Page height ~7330px, all 6 sections render with substantial heights (hero 1093, scroll-moment 600, collection 3389, gifts 751, final-cta 1124, footer 373). Hero has correct copy + only /shop CTA (no gifts CTA). ScrollMoment contains the three required lines. Collection shows all 6 products (Amara/Celeste/Noa/Elodie/Camille/Aurelia) each linking to /shop with 'View Invitation' hover text. All CTA hrefs correct: header-shop-cta, hero-shop-cta, explore-cards-cta, final-shop-cta, footer-wedding-cards → /shop; explore-gifts-cta, footer-gifts → /gifts; footer-instagram → https://instagram.com. Header background transitions from transparent (rgba(0,0,0,0)) at top to ivory (rgba(247,243,239,0.9)) after scroll. Mobile (390x844) menu toggle opens menu with all nav links; hero stacks; images all load. Reduced-motion mode: window.__lenis is undefined (disabled correctly), native scroll works to bottom, all sections still render with same heights, no broken images.

issues: Individual mobile menu nav links lack data-testid attributes (menu itself has data-testid=mobile-menu, but inner links do not). Not requested by spec but would improve testability.

critical_code_review_comments: Console warning from Framer Motion useScroll: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Likely originates from Hero.jsx parallax target — add position:relative to the ref container to silence.
One 404 network resource observed on initial load (likely favicon or manifest). Non-blocking but worth cleaning up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All landing page requirements pass. If future work adds /shop or /gifts pages, remember commercial links are currently intentional placeholders. Lenis is exposed at window.__lenis for programmatic scrolling; use window.__lenis.scrollTo(y,{immediate:true}) instead of window.scrollTo to avoid smooth-scroll fighting tests.
